playlist_ids = [225,224,227,226]
max_pid=None
max_total_seconds=0
details=[]
for pid in playlist_ids:
    resp = apis.spotify.show_playlist(playlist_id=pid, access_token=access_token)
    songs=resp.get('songs',[])
    total_seconds=sum([s.get('duration',0) or 0 for s in songs])
    details.append((pid, resp.get('title'), len(songs), total_seconds))
    if total_seconds>max_total_seconds:
        max_total_seconds=total_seconds
        max_pid=pid
print('details', details)
print('max_pid', max_pid)
max_minutes = max_total_seconds/60
print('max_total_seconds', max_total_seconds)
print('max_minutes_raw', max_minutes)
print('rounded', int(round(max_minutes)))
